name: ask-me-again
description: Re-asks an agent's open questions one at a time, in one fixed shape, with every recommended fix checked first.

interface.shortDescription: Re-ask open questions one at a time, in a clear shape.
interface.longDescription: Takes every question the agent has open, checks the facts behind each and that each recommended fix works, then asks them again in plain chat, one per message: a numbered claim, the situation, a numbered flow to the consequence, the fix, its cost, and your call. It waits for a direct apply, reject, or different direction before it asks the next one or does any work.
